# Rent Apartment Milan (RAM)

> Furnished apartments in north-east Milan (Precotto and Turro, M1 red line) for short stays and monthly stays, managed personally by Vito Semeraro. Book directly with the host: no agency fee, monthly stays with bills included, registered contract and no three-month deposit.

- Contact: hello@rent-apartment-milan.com, +39 328 061 4612
- Address: Via Jean Jaurès 7/B, 20125 Milano, Italy
- Languages: English, Italiano, Español, Français, Deutsch

## Apartments
- [Bright Precotto home for up to 8 · two connected flats · M1](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/apartments/precotto-comfort-apartment-m1/): Two connected flats for families and groups up to 8, 350 m from the M1. from €85/night, minimum 2 nights, up to 8 guests.
- [Design apartment · M1 Precotto](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/apartments/precotto-design-apartment-m1/): A new home in Precotto, currently being prepared. Be the first to book it. opening soon.
- [Authentic Milanese studio · M1 Turro](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/apartments/studio-turro-martesana/): Seventh floor, balcony and rooftop views, 2 minutes from the metro. monthly stays from about €1580/month, minimum 30 nights.
- [Quiet one-bedroom with balcony · M1 Precotto](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/apartments/one-bedroom-val-di-non-balcony/): Balcony with city views, desk and gigabit fibre, near Bicocca. monthly stays from about €2350/month, minimum 28 nights.

## Guides
- [Apartments with no deposit](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/apartments-milan-no-deposit/): Rent a furnished studio or flat in Milan without the usual 3-month deposit: bills and Wi-Fi included, registered contract, 2 min from the M1 metro. Monthly stays.
- [Monthly rentals in Milan](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/monthly-rentals-milan/): How to rent a furnished apartment in Milan for 1 to 12 months: prices, contracts, deposits and areas. Flats on the M1 with bills included and registered lease.
- [Student housing in Milan](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/student-housing-milan/): Apartments for students in Milan: how to rent near Politecnico, Bicocca, Bocconi and IULM, student lease, Erasmus tips and furnished flats on the M1 with bills included.
- [Apartments near Bicocca](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/apartment-near-bicocca-university/): Furnished apartments a short walk from Milano-Bicocca University and the Bicocca business district, near M1 Precotto. Monthly stays, bills included, registered contract.
- [Trade fairs & Salone del Mobile](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/apartment-milan-trade-fair-rho-salone/): Stay on the M1 red line, the metro that goes straight to Rho Fiera Milano: apartments for groups up to 8 for Salone del Mobile, MIDO, MICAM, EICMA and Fashion Week.
- [Precotto, Turro & Martesana guide](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/precotto-turro-martesana-neighbourhood-guide/): Living in Precotto and Turro, north-east Milan: Naviglio Martesana, NoLo nightlife, Villa Finzi park, transport, supermarkets and where to eat.
- [Transitional lease in Milan](https://rent-apartment-milan.com/transitional-lease-contract-milan/): What a transitional lease is in Italy, how long it lasts, which documents you need, registration, deposit and residence. A clear guide for expats and students in Milan.
